title: Access token claims
description: Claims inside an access token (RS256 JWT, 10 minute lifetime). Owner: auth service. Verified by the cauth library in the main app. `version` is the claims version: cauth accepts the current version N and N-1, so a breaking change ships expand-then-contract (see libs/README.md).

role.description: Role at issue time; a role change lands on the next refresh.

iat.description: Issued at, seconds since the epoch.

version.description: Claims version. The values are the versions cauth.SUPPORTED_VERSIONS accepts (N and N-1); a test ties them.
